title: The Vintage Chateau Heist
logline: A disgruntled cellar hand at a renowned orbital vineyard tries to preserve an authentic century-old wine cask before management can replace it with toxic synthetic spirits.

roles.description: Curator of the elite orbital vineyard dome; polished, aristocratic, fiercely protective of the estate's mythos.
Tended the orbital aging casks for forty years; coughing from sulfur fumes, heartbroken by corporate shortcuts.
A syndicate of luxury spirit houses holding exclusive distribution patents across the sector.
A rotating botanical dome station producing celebrated vintages under artificial starlight.
A bustling neutral dock where independent merchant guilds inspect and certify bulk commodities.

public_situation: The prestigious orbital vineyard in {system} prepares for its centennial gala, advertising tasting flights of its legendary hundred-year oak vintage.
private_truth: {role:master_vintner} substituted ordinary irradiated mash spiked with prohibited chemical aromatics for the gala vintage, intending to destroy {role:veteran_cellarer}'s last genuine oak barrel.

beats.public_change: The orbital chateau posts an off-the-books scanning contract to check radiation seals around its outer cellars.

missions.reason: The vintner hires the pilot to scan the estate's outer storage cellar to certify that radiation wash from the star has not breached the aging seals.
missions.private_fact: He deliberately opened the cellar's solar vents to artificially accelerate fermentation with forbidden gamma rays.

beats.public_change: {role:veteran_cellarer} secretly contacts the pilot, begging for assistance in removing the estate's last genuine heritage barrel.

missions.reason: The cellarer pays the pilot to collect the genuine antique oak cask from a hidden crawlway before the vintner destroys it.
missions.private_fact: He hid the authentic cask in an unmonitored air reclamation shaft to protect it from synthetic adulteration.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the authentic hundred-year cask. {role:master_vintner} offers a massive bribe to return it, while {role:distillery_consortium} wants it to force a corporate buyout.

options.label: Return the cask to the master vintner for hush money
Haul the cask to the public trade depot for certification

beats.public_change: Port authorities announce an emergency historical appraisal hearing at the public trade depot.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to deliver the heritage barrel safely to the public depot guild masters to register it as protected cultural property.
missions.private_fact: Public registration will trigger an immediate mandatory assay of the chateau's remaining commercial stocks.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot registers the heritage cask at the public depot, proving the chateau's current production is synthetic fraud.
resolutions.summary: The authentic cask is registered as cultural heritage. {role:master_vintner} faces criminal fraud charges, and {role:veteran_cellarer} receives an artisan pension.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot hauled the last real barrel of hundred-year wine out of an aristocratic fake.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot returns the cask to the vintner for a private payoff.
resolutions.summary: {role:master_vintner} burns the cask and serves synthetic wine to the gala. {role:veteran_cellarer} is quietly banished from {role:orbital_vineyard_chateau}.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot diverts the cask to consortium representatives, who use it to blackmail the estate.
resolutions.summary: {role:distillery_consortium} uses proof of adulteration to seize the vineyard. {role:master_vintner} is ousted, and production is fully industrialized.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot ignores the contract or abandons the cellarer's plea.
resolutions.summary: The gala takes place as planned, serving synthetic liquor to oblivious aristocrats. {role:veteran_cellarer} is fired without back pay.

loose_threads.detail: A shipping crate in the cellar holds industrial chemical barrels labeled with a banned cosmetic dye patent.
The chateau's centennial pedigree certificate bears an assay registry number belonging to a scrapped ore barge.
Debt covenants on the orbital vineyard dome were quietly assigned to a blind offshore holding trust.

radio_hooks: Centennial gala tickets at {role:orbital_vineyard_chateau} fetch record prices on the luxury exchange.
Guild inspectors report unusual synthetic aromatic residue in system waste reclamation channels.
Prominent socialites arrive in {system} for annual vintage tasting exhibition.

voice_direction.master_vintner: Grand, perfumed eloquence that drips with condescension. Uses archaic botanical jargon to evade direct questions about chemical additives.
voice_direction.veteran_cellarer: Low, gravelly rasp delivered in weary murmurs. Speaks of oak barrels like fallen comrades and curses modern synthetic chemists.
